CommunityApplications.Profile: Templates for [Lyftr](https://github.com/Cawlumm/lyftr), an MIT-licensed workout and nutrition tracker, maintained by its developer. Lyftr runs as two containers: install Lyftr-Backend (the API and SQLite database) first, then Lyftr (the web UI). Report problems at https://github.com/Cawlumm/lyftr/issues; documentation is at https://lyftr-app.pages.dev.
